name: ai-dlc-socratic-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for AI-DLC with embedded Socratic elicitation and review

scripts.generate: node scripts/generate-stages.js && node scripts/generate-knowledge.js && node scripts/generate-memory.js
scripts.build: npm run generate && tsc && mkdir -p dist/stages dist/knowledge dist/memory && cp -R src/stages/* dist/stages/ 2>/dev/null && cp -R src/knowledge/* dist/knowledge/ 2>/dev/null && cp -R src/memory/* dist/memory/ 2>/dev/null || true
